narrative.overview:
The picture is a drawing that lies flat on a table. The shell is the furniture around it: rails, a header under the lamp, a tray at the foot of each column and a few pieces of gold hardware. An agent drew the picture, and the architect reads it. Nothing in the shell competes with the picture for attention, and nothing in the shell paints on it.

The shell is dense desktop chrome at 1920×1080. It uses 13px controls, 28px rows and small corners. Its neutrals are warm graphite and chalk, tinted toward the hue of the gold. Depth comes from planes, not from lines. The chrome stands on the picture and casts a short, warm, still shadow onto it. Controls stand on the chrome with a highlight on their top edge. Menus and dialogs float above everything. One warm yellow-gold marks what is chosen. It also marks the one primary action of a region, and that action is drawn as a physical piece of gold.
keyCharacteristics: The picture is the ground. The shell sits around it and over it.
Planes stack under a light from above. Each plane has a tone step, a highlight on its top edge and a warm shadow with an offset.
One gold has three uses: what is chosen, the one primary action, and the voice and the brand mark.
Tall condensed capitals set a name as a title. Plain sans sets every other word. Mono sets technical tokens only.
The shell is for the desktop only, near full screen at 1920×1080.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks what is chosen, the one primary action of a region, and the voice and the brand mark. Nothing else is gold.

rules.name: The Ink On Chalk Rule
rules.body: Text on chalk is never gold. A gold dark enough to clear 4.5:1 on chalk reads as brown. Text stays in the ink, and a gold mark beside or under it carries the accent. On graphite, accent text is the gold itself (oklch(0.86 0.125 86)).

rules.name: The Untouched Picture Rule
rules.body: The renderer draws the picture. The shell never paints gold, shadow or decoration on a card in it.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Mono sets technical tokens only. It never sets a label or a heading.

rules.name: The Still Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow over the picture is a static box-shadow, and a panel's shadow never changes while the panel moves. Nothing over the picture viewport uses backdrop-filter, filter or blur, and nothing there loops except the voice orb in the voice box, which is drawn on a canvas of its own and only while voice is on, and the warm wash the box takes from the orb's light, which is a layer of the box and never of the picture. A tip, a menu, the floating sidebar, the walkthrough box or the voice box may ease its own layer's transform and opacity, once, and each word of a subtitle may ease its own opacity, once. The floating sidebar takes at most 160ms, the walkthrough box 220ms to arrive and 520ms to hand one step to the next, with the wake on its rail settling by about 700ms, and the voice box 360ms to arrive and 240ms to leave. A box that is wanted again while it leaves turns round from where it is. The orb itself crosses the page when subtitles are turned on or off, in a layer of its own, over 680ms.

rules.name: The Picture Answers Rule
rules.body: The light belongs to the picture, not to the shell. When a part is picked out or the pointer rests on one, the viewer marks what stays as drawn, and the picture's own subjects recede under an opacity filter. The shell lays no layer, blur or halo over the picture to do it.

rules.name: The Card Is a Window Rule
rules.body: A card that opens a board is a window onto it. The board opens when the camera flies into the card, and going back flies out of it. The board's picture sits inside the card, in the picture's own units, so one camera carries both and the board that opens stands where the board in the card stood. The shell adds no layer for the flight.

rules.name: The Planes Not Lines Rule
rules.body: Regions read as layered planes. A one-pixel rule stays only where it draws the edge of a control or a card, or where it divides regions on one plane.

dos: Do draw the one primary action of a region with `primary-finish`, and only that one.
Do separate regions with tone steps and elevation tokens before you add a rule.
Do keep shadows warm and offset. Take them from the elevation tokens in app.css.
Do keep the ink on gold at Gold Ink (at least 8.5:1).
donts: Do not put backdrop-filter, filter, blur or a looping animation over the picture viewport.
Do not take a control out of a row when it cannot be used. Dim it and say why in its tooltip, so the row does not move.
Do not paint gold or decoration onto a card in the picture.
Do not use a grey-black blur or a halo without an offset as a shadow.
Do not add a phone or narrow layout.
Do not set a label or a heading in mono.
